The 2004–05 season of [[Ligue 1]] was a very close-run battle. Separating fourth placed [[Stade Rennais FC|Rennes]], who enter the [[UEFA Cup]] and 18th placed [[SM Caen|Caen]], who get relegated to [[Ligue 2]], were just 13 points. [[Olympique Lyonnais|Lyon]] were long time leaders and had won the league back in April 2005. On the last day, 4 teams could have got the 4th place guaranteeing a place in the [[UEFA Cup]] and any 2 from 6 teams could have been relegated before the final games.
